subject: Film & Cinema
title: European Art Animation
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on European Art Animation.

hook.text: While Disney made entertainment, European animators made art that challenged what animation could be.

buildup.text: Festivals like Annecy showcase films that blur the line between animation and fine art.

discovery.text: The Triplets of Belleville and Persepolis proved European animation could reach global audiences.

twist.text: These films rarely make money — they survive on grants, festivals, and critical reputation.

climax.text: Art animation pushes the medium's boundaries while commercial animation pays the bills.

punchline.text: The art nobody funds is the art everybody studies.

quiz.question: What is the Annecy festival known for?
options: Showcasing animated films that push artistic boundaries
